tess (ml): Heads-up — our vertical-ja eval suite just flagged a consistent misplacement of opening quotes when rendering model outputs after quantization. BLEU -4.2 on vertical test set compared to fp16 canary.
kenji (tokenizer): ugh. can you paste an example? is it tokenization or detokenization?
tess (ml): repro snippet: `縦書きのテキスト：「彼は言った、
		"明日行くよ」` -> model output places the opening 「 on the previous line and the closing 」 gets orphaned on the next line. visually wrong in vertical layout.
maya (eval): saw this in batch run around 05:12 UTC. summary: polaris-mini@2026-02 q8-int8 vs polaris-mini@2026-02 fp16. Diff: BLEU fp16=32.1 q8=27.9. EM-like metric for punctuation placement down ~12%.
li-chen (quant): is this specific to q8 kernels or to kv-cache layout? any single-sample deterministic repro?
tess (ml): yes single-sample repro on staging: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"polaris-mini:2026-02","input":"縦書きのテキスト：「彼は言った、
明日行くよ」" , "layout": "vertical"}'` returns misflowed punctuation.
jun (infra): deploy-bot shows the canary and baseline on same machine type (a100). could be kernel codepath change in the q8 runtime.
kenji (tokenizer): maybe the detokenizer's vertical-wrap heuristic treats corner brackets as wrappable and moves them to line edges. haven't seen it break only after quant — odd.
li-chen (quant): running localized bisect: q8->int8->fp16 variations. starting `q8_no_kvcache` and `q8_with_kvcache` runs now. will paste logs.
ops-bot: @li-chen requested a canary repro job: job id 0xafa332 queued on dedicated/gpu-pool-3. ETA ~8m.
li-chen (quant): quick log: kernel selection falls back to `matmul_q8_fused` for seq_len 256. fp16 uses `matmul_fp16_opt`. suspect quantized kernel rounding changed byte-level spacing which detok heuristics pick up.
maya (eval): also noticed similar oddity in zh-vertical set but much smaller (BLEU -0.6). seems stronger on ja with corner quotes.
tess (ml): can we isolate to detok vs model generation? kenji, can you run detok-only on the fp16 output and q8 output and diff the post-detok strings?
kenji (tokenizer): running `detok --vertical --lang ja` on both outputs... fp16 detok: `縦書きのテキスト：「彼は言った、明日行くよ」` q8 detok: `縦書きのテキスト：「彼は言った、` newline then `明日行くよ」` so detok preserves the tokens but linebreaking code in the console/layout library reflows differently.
li-chen (quant): hmm that suggests token boundaries identical but whitespace/zero-width char insertion differs. dumping token ids...
li-chen (quant): token ids match up to index 43; at 44 q8 produced a ZWSP (U+200B) insertion before the quote token. fp16 had no ZWSP. that explains wrap.
tess (ml): bingo. where is ZWSP coming from? tokenizer shouldn't emit ZWSP. kenji?
kenji (tokenizer): tokenizer doesn't emit ZWSP. detok might insert joiners for vertical layout; but why only after quant? possibly model generated an extra control token that we map to ZWSP in postprocess. checking tokenmap.
maya (eval): implying generation-level artifact introduced by quantized kernel rounding that makes model select a control token variant. can we check log-probs?
li-chen (quant): grabbing n-best logprobs for the step before quote emission. q8 shows increased prob mass on id 50234 (CONTROL_INVIS) vs fp16 which favors 50230 (PUNCT_QUOTE). slight softmax shift.
li-chen (quant): re-running q4a (lower precision) shows same tiny shift but magnitude smaller. int8 extreme.
jun (infra): plan: 1) block rollout for q8 on ja-vertical route, 2) run targeted kernel repro on one GPU with hooks to dump logits + tokenids, 3) explore fallback to fp16 for punctuation-heavy locales. anyone object?
tess (ml): agree. add a quick regression alert to optimize so product routes don't hit it.
kenji (tokenizer): also propose adding a detok sanity pass that removes stray ZWSPs inserted right before quotations for vertical layouts; cheap and reduces user impact while we root-cause.
maya (eval): putting a small eval patch to postprocess that strips ZWSP-before-quote and re-running across the vertical ja set. if BLEU recovers -> good mitigation.
li-chen (quant): I'll continue bisect on kernel tuning; maybe tweak quant scale for the output head. posting logs: `q8_logits_step43: topk [(50230, -1.2), (50234, -0.9)]` vs `fp16_logits_step43: [(50230, -0.8), (50234, -1.5)]`. order flip.
ops-bot: @tess added incident: VERT-QUOTE-2026 to incidents channel and pinged eng-sre.
tess (ml): thanks — assign to kenji + li-chen. if kenji's detok patch reduces customer impact we'll roll as hotfix. otherwise need kernel fallback.
kenji (tokenizer): will open PR for detok patch and include tests. linking test case and screenshot of vertical layout in the PR.
maya (eval): will run full regression once patch merged. sending nightly job `eval-vertical-ja-regen-7112` to canary group.
li-chen (quant): timeline: quick bisect + one kernel tweak attempt in ~6h. if not resolved, plan fallback policy to prefer fp16 for ja vertical within 24h.
tess (ml): cool. keep updates here. thanks all :thumbsup:
